messages:
alex: Heads-up — we should consolidate a short PRD/edge list for generation API edge-cases (streaming resume, truncation semantics, token-limit behavior, retry policy). Two recent customers (FinEdge & DocuFlow) pushed this to the top of requests and legal asked for deterministic truncation for auditing.
maria: Agreed. Can we pick a single owner and a minimal launch scope? I want something we can ship in 2 sprints, not a massive spec. :hourglass:
sam: I volunteer to own the engineering side. Proposed minimal scope: 1) clear error codes + recovery for token-limit, 2) deterministic truncation policy for both chunked and non-chunked responses, 3) streaming resume semantics for reconnect within 30s, 4) backoff/retry guidance and default headers so SDKs can auto-retry safely.
product-ana: Nice. For launch criteria I suggest:
- MUST: doc with exact JSON payload examples for each error + SDK guidance
- MUST: e2e test that simulates mid-stream truncation and verifies auditable truncation reason
- SHOULD: allow customer-configurable resume window (default 30s)
- SHOULD: telemetry for truncated_count, resumed_streams, retry_rate
- MAY: cross-model resume (defer to v2)
ryan: Quick question — for deterministic truncation, do we truncate at token boundary or byte boundary? Legal wants replayability.
sam: Token boundary. We need deterministic tokenization path. Implementation note: store prefix-kv + checkpoint token index at stream boundary.
alex: Example payloads would help. Suggest we standardize on these error codes: `GEN_TRUNCATED`, `GEN_TOKEN_LIMIT`, `GEN_STREAM_RESET`, `GEN_RETRY_EXHAUSTED`. Include `resume_after` field when applicable.
maria: +1. Also include `truncation_policy` header: `truncate:earliest|truncate:smart|truncate:strict` — docs should recommend `strict` for audits.
product-ana: Acceptance test matrix (high level):
- client sends stream, server truncates due to max_tokens -> client receives `GEN_TRUNCATED` with `truncation_policy=strict` and final `stop_reason: token_limit` -> verify logs show token index
- client disconnects at token N, reconnects within 30s -> `resume_after` present and engine serves remainder -> metric `resumed_streams++`
- retry loop: transient `GEN_STREAM_RESET` -> SDK retries with exponential backoff, but `GEN_RETRY_EXHAUSTED` if >3 tries
ryan: Edge-case: what if model uses dynamic padding/temperature that produces non-deterministic tokens? Need to lock RNG/temperature for resumed sessions. Add to acceptance criteria.
sam: Good catch. Implementation constraint: resume only supported when `seed` and `sampling_mode` are fixed. Otherwise response must fail with `GEN_RESUME_UNSUPPORTED`.
alex: Scope negotiation: defer multi-region active-failover and cross-model resume to v2. Aim for hosted + dedicated parity for basics. Private deployments: add KMS logging requirement later.
ci-bot: new PR created -> https://git.internal.redwood/infra/gen-edgecases-specs/pull/42 :memo:
maria: Cool. I'll draft the PRD outline (2 pages) and drop it in the PR today. Sam, can you add a minimal test harness snippet? e.g.:
```
# pseudo
start_stream(req)
simulate_disconnect(after_tokens=45)
reconnect(resume_token_index=45)
assert final_output == golden[45:]
```
sam: Yep will add unit + integration test stubs. I'll also add a small section on telemetry names and SLOs.
alex: Thanks team. Next steps: Maria publishes PRD, Sam pushes tests, Product reviews + a short API spec document. Sync in async — follow-ups in the PR. :thumbsup:
